metadata.subject: A JPEG 2000 image block passed through as /JPXDecode (pdfnative ≥ 1.9.0) — the codestream is never decoded

blocks.text: An image block whose src is a .jp2 file (or a raw .j2k codestream) is embedded with the /JPXDecode filter, with the colour space and opacity its header declares; the header of the file is raised to PDF 1.5. The image below is the engine's minimal 8 × 8 RGB codestream (a flat mid-grey) — the point is the filter, not the picture.

blocks.alt: An 8 by 8 JPEG 2000 image, flat mid-grey

blocks.text: Under PDF/A-1 the filter is not allowed (PDFA1_JPX_IMAGE); under PDF/A-2 and PDF/A-3 an opacity channel or an unusual channel count is reported (PDFA_JPX_IMAGE). --strict turns either into E_CHECK_FAILED.
